title: Rise of the Tomb Raider

d3d12.selection: the default (owner, 2026-10-01: D3D12 wherever a game offers it): the game's own DirectX 12 option (added in patch 5, build 1.0.638.6), registry value EnableDX12, 0 by the game's default. smoke\rottr-settings.ps1 -SetDx12 1 turns it on before the session (it prints the previous value) and -SetDx12 <that value> puts it back after; the runtime refuses a session whose EnableDX12 does not match (registry). In DirectX 12 mode the game still opens a D3D11 probe device at startup, so ROTTR.exe has to be on the router's allowlist (app_router): off it the probe went to the CPU UMD (FL 10_0) and the game died within 1 s on a NULL read in its own code, before any D3D12 module loaded (rottr5, 2026-10-01, crashpad 3092a488); on it the game ran on D3D12 and rendered the benchmark correctly (rottr6: amdgpu_wddm_d3d12 0CE9D4F8, vkd3d 15E3E24E and radv B4D82C4E of the registered triplet, plus app-route-icdmt's D3D11 UMD for the probe). The registered triplet carries the static-CRT ICD B4D82C4E since 2026-10-01; its predecessor 2A13235D imports MSVCP140 (the 825e4a49 class)

registry.name: EnableDX12

d3d11.selection: a variant (SESSION_API=d3d11): the game's DirectX 12 option off (EnableDX12 0, the game's own default; lab smoke 2026-10-01); ROTTR.exe on the router's allowlist for the session with GpuUmdPath in the static-CRT root C:\BC250\m14\app-route-icdmt (shell 7E9F1692, engine 7D28D8F5, ICD B4D82C4E; app_router), on which rottr4 (2026-10-01) ran the whole benchmark without a fault. The deployed root app-route-001 (shell E748418C) carries ICD D672813F, which imports MSVCP140 and crashed in the game's copy (825e4a49)

registry.name: EnableDX12

steam.launch_entry: 0: ROTTR.exe, type default, no arguments; entries 1, 2, 4 and 5 need DLC 437290, entry 6 (ROTTR.exe -nolauncher -vr, type vr) needs DLC 505540 (appinfo cache of 2026-09-30)

app_router.required: ROTTR.exe has to reach the application GPU UMD, for the game's D3D11 probe device in DirectX 12 mode as well (rottr5 and rottr6 of 2026-10-01: on the CPU UMD the probe got FL 10_0 and the game died). The release default AppRouter Mode gpu-default (since b19) does that with no Allow entry; the runtime refuses the session otherwise, and also when the router's GPU UMD is not the profile's d3d11 witness
app_router.rules: Under gpu-default nothing is set before or after a session. Only a lab left in Mode allowlist needs the game in Allow; check first, and put the release default back with the installer's values, not with an old root.

app_profile.proposal: none: no ray tracing in this game (raytracing-tier not needed); the present and engine levers stay off until a first session shows the default path.

notes: -nolauncher: Nixxes, 'skips the launcher and goes directly into the game' (Steam discussion 451852571443443970). Without it ROTTR.exe opens its own settings launcher first. Lab smoke 2026-10-01: Steam starts ROTTR.exe (64-bit) directly, no launcher process; the router's first OpenAdapter10_2 at launch + 3.0 s, more at + 20.8 s and + 21.7 s (the device recreated for the game window).

Start (lab smoke and rottr4, 2026-10-01): fullscreen 1920x1200, black for the first ~40 s (not a G4 image fault), then logos that two held Enters skip (rottr4: hold:1C:300 twice; the smoke used hold:1C:500), then about 25 s of loading to the main menu, a 3D scene. The very first start also showed the Square Enix terms (ToS/EULA), accepted by the owner by hand.
Input (lab smoke, rottr4): mouse hover registers, but a menu item activates only with Enter: a click on the item, then Enter held at least 300 ms.

Menu selection (b28 validation, 2026-10-10): the main menu wraps around, so counted Down presses can land on CONTINUE instead of START BENCHMARK, and CONTINUE loads the story. Select the item with clickat, take a shot:0.5, and press Enter only when the shot shows the wanted item highlighted.

Benchmark (rottr4, coordinates as fractions of the 1920x1200 screen): START BENCHMARK is on the main menu (clickat:0.170:0.503, hold:1C:300; the smoke went through Options > Graphics > Run Benchmark); its load took about 3 min; the results dialog's OK (hold:1C:300) returns to the main menu after about 25 s. Quit: QUIT GAME (clickat:0.140:0.424, hold:1C:400), then a Yes/No dialog with No preselected: Yes is clickat:0.407:0.545, hold:1C:300. rottr4 took 18 min (20:20-20:38Z).

rottr4 (2026-10-01, D3D11 variant on the static-CRT root app-route-icdmt; preset HIGH, 1920x1200 borderless fullscreen, FXAA, VSync off, DX12 off): Mountain Peak 3.05 fps (min 0.09, max 60.67), Syria 1.27, Geothermal Valley 9.76, overall 2.68, no fault; GPU busy about 0 %, the stalls are inline shader compiles (K110/K111 in scratch\m15\offgpu\KNOWLEDGE.md).

D3D12 (2026-10-01): rottr5 (20:50:55Z, ROTTR.exe off the allowlist) died within 1 s in its own code on the CPU UMD's D3D11 probe device (crashpad 3092a488; modules d3d11, d3d12, dxgi, bc250d3d only); rottr6 (ROTTR.exe on the allowlist, root app-route-icdmt) ran on D3D12 and rendered the benchmark correctly.

World mark of the benchmark (270, 2026-10-01, D3D12 VERY HIGH with the switches of the Witcher 3 application profile): shots of the running scenes capture black, and loading screens with tips sit between the menu and the benchmark in both directions, so a shot cannot place note:world. In 270's game log (command times, shot sizes: 4627-byte shots at 0.33 are black) the first black scene frame came 46 and 56 s after the two START BENCHMARK confirms and the results about 150 and 135 s after them: note:world+60 sent with the confirm (apis.d3d12.world_after_confirm_s) puts a 60 s window inside the scenes. The D3D11 variant's load took about 3 min in rottr4 and 4.5 min in the smoke: there N follows the load seen.

Smoke (2026-10-01) on the app-route-throttle quartet (shell 7E9F1692, engine 7D28D8F5, ICD D672813F r5): the benchmark's load took about 4.5 min, CPU-bound (inline ACO compiles on the game thread), and its first frame hit a GPU SQC instruction-fetch fault at an unmapped ICD 32-bit-heap VA, then 0x116 (scratch\m15\game-recon\bsod-rottr1).

Graphics settings live in the registry: HKU\<bc250's SID>\Software\Crystal Dynamics\Rise of the Tomb Raider, created by the first start (smoke\rottr-settings.ps1 lists them; the DirectX 12 option is EnableDX12, in a subkey). The runner changes nothing there; the runtime reads EnableDX12 before the launch (apis.<api>.registry).
Patch 7: the Steam overlay is disabled under DirectX 12.

The install folder ships its own msvcp140.dll (crashpad report 825e4a49 of the 2026-10-01 smoke); a DLL that imports MSVCP140 by name gets that copy in ROTTR.exe. The msvcp140.dll module note shows which copy a process loaded.
